# Jeromy Kovatana

Jeromy Kovatana is the CTO of GOAT Leads and a marketing-systems consultant for insurance agencies. He builds lead generation machines: paid acquisition, funnels, CRM architecture, and automation for agencies, IMOs, and FMOs spending $50K+/month on growth.

## Proof points

- $38M+ in ad spend managed across Meta and Google
- 1.63M+ unique consumer leads generated
- 16,000+ agents on the GOAT Leads platform
